name: Ben Lambert Factor Analysis and SEM
desc: Lecture series by Ben Lambert introducing factor analysis and structural equation modeling from first principles: model representation in scalar and matrix form, model assumptions, derivation of the variance-covariance matrix, predicted variance and covariance of indicators, covariance between indicators and factors, the model-implied variance-covariance matrix, and maximum likelihood estimation of factor analysis models.
